blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – South division powerhouses Talisay City and Naga City remained unbeaten after scoring their third straight victories in the Governor’s Cup U18 Basketball Tournament on Saturday, October 17, at the Municipality of Sibonga in southern Cebu. The back-to-back defending champions from Talisay City routed the Municipality of Badian, 88-42, to seize the […]...
